paragraphs: Zeira: Rabbi Shimon was his son. [Glosses: Zeira. A) Menachot 40b: “In Rav Zeira’s name like me; Rabbi Zeira said, a decree”—this is how it should read. L.T. B) Tosafot, Chagigah 10, beginning of side a: Rav Kahana fasted to forget Babylonian learning. It seems to me a scribal error, for Rabbi Zeira fasted. L.T. C) Shabbat 71a: Rabbi Zeira asked Rabbi Assi; this is how it should read, also in newer Talmud editions. D) Keritot 27, end of side a: Rabbi Zeira bar Adda reviewed his learning. Beer Sheva writes it is a scribal error for Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba reviewing …. L.T. E) Kiddushin 9a: Rabbi Zeira bar Mammal. No other mention is found throughout the Talmud; perhaps it is a scribal error for Rabbi Abba bar Mammal. Or, since Rabbi Zeira speaks to Rabbi Abba bar Mammal, it should read “He objects to Rabbi Abba bar Mammal.” Not corrected.]
